"3D first-person psychological horror game set in a surreal architectural museum where gravity changes based on player blinking. Low-poly retro-surrealist art style, eerie ambient soundscape of whispering limestone and ticking clocks. Core mechanic: the player must navigate a shifting labyrinth of stairs and rooms, but objects permanently leave behind glowing sonic footprints of the player's past actions. An invisible entity hunts the player not by sight or sound, but by consuming the historical echoes left behind. Win condition: reach the central archive by erasing your own footprints before the entity catches up. Minimalist UI, zero combat, pure atmospheric dread.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
